anchor.quote: A machine that swaps two fields of $u$ cells each
anchor.note: u is first used, and only used, in an example. The example says the fields have u cells each but never says that u denotes this, so the reader cannot be sure what u counts.

gaps.term: Counters and head return cost per scan
gaps.quote: Each scan also includes its own counters and the return of its heads, which costs only a bounded amount per scan.
gaps.note: The page asserts that the counters and the return of the heads cost only a bounded amount per scan, with no argument or citation. The reader cannot check this from the page.

gaps.term: Scan count of interchanges grows with field width
gaps.quote: the number of scans it needs grows with the field width
gaps.note: The page asserts that interchanging two fields needs a number of scans that grows with the field width, which is the reason interchange is not primitive. No argument or citation is given, so the reader cannot check it.
